added: My Gear can hold kits, sets of items that weigh what their items weigh.
Open a kit on My Gear to change it right there: how many of each item it holds, take one out, or add one from your gear.
Make any piece a kit from its edit dialog, or save a group on a list with its own Save to My Gear.
A kit from My Gear goes onto a list as a group, each item a row under it, so you can leave one out for that trip.
The My Gear panel in a list has a Kits tab, and adding a kit from it can be undone.
Changing a kit on My Gear, or making it a single piece, can be undone.
An assistant connected to Mahonia can make and change your kits.
My Gear has Gear and Kits tabs at the top, where a list has its Gear, Packing and Trip, and the Kits tab can start a new kit by name.
changed: My Gear groups your gear by kind, with kits first, instead of folders you file by hand; the My Gear panel in a list does too.
A kit holds no more of a piece than you own.
Pick a piece's icon from a popover on its row in My Gear, or from the Icon box in its edit dialog.
The My Gear panel in a list shows where a click adds gear beside its tabs.
My Gear's top bar has your list switcher, so every list is one tap away.
A kit's items show their icons when it's open.
A kit is edited on its row in My Gear: rename it, change its items, or make it a single piece. Kits no longer have an edit dialog or a note.
My Gear's edit dialog keeps its paired fields side by side in a narrow window instead of stacking them.
fixed: Searching your gear to add an item to a kit offers only real matches, not your most-used gear.
